title: Hack it!
statementMd:
Little X has met the following problem recently.

Let's define $*f*(*x*)$ as the sum of digits in decimal representation of number $*x*$ (for example, $*f*(1234) = 1 + 2 + 3 + 4$). You are to calculate ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/3544ececd2159fbc9d8edc9ba99dbbfa79739157.png)

Of course Little X has solved this problem quickly, has locked it, and then has tried to hack others. He has seen the following C++ code:

```
    ans = solve(l, r) % a;
    if (ans <= 0)
      ans += a;
```

This code will fail only on the test with

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/4b3d0d465d72291386b3afa4fd8af81c1a6a1a6e.png)

. You are given number

*a*

, help Little X to find a proper test for hack.

## Input

The first line contains a single integer $*a* (1 ≤ *a* ≤ 10^{18})$.

## Output

Print two integers: $*l*, *r* (1 ≤ *l* ≤ *r* < 10^{200})$ — the required test data. Leading zeros aren't allowed. It's guaranteed that the solution exists.
statementZhMd:
小 X 最近遇到了下面的问题。

我们定义 $*f*(*x*)$ 为数字 $*x*$ 的十进制表示中各位数字之和（例如，$*f*(1234) = 1 + 2 + 3 + 4$）。你需要计算

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/3544ececd2159fbc9d8edc9ba99dbbfa79739157.png)

当然，小 X 很快就解决了这个问题，提交并锁定了代码，然后尝试 hack 其他人。他看到了下面的 C++ 代码：

```
    ans = solve(l, r) % a;
    if (ans <= 0)
      ans += a;
```

这段代码只会在满足下图条件的测试数据上出错：

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/4b3d0d465d72291386b3afa4fd8af81c1a6a1a6e.png)

给定一个数

*a*

请帮助小 X 找到一个合适的测试数据来进行 hack。

## 输入格式

第一行包含一个整数 $*a* (1 ≤ *a* ≤ 10^{18})$。

## 输出格式

输出两个整数：$*l*, *r* (1 ≤ *l* ≤ *r* < 10^{200})$，表示所需的测试数据。不允许有前导零。保证解一定存在。
